geometry_edits.rationale: Expand the courtyard carve to make the open-space figure more public and spatially consequential.
Orient the courtyard opening toward the access edge to reinforce the public threshold.
Slightly extend the cantilevered dominant mass to preserve the strong gesture while improving threshold depth.

graph_edits.rationale: Enlarge and clarify the carved public figure so the court reads more as a usable neighborhood void than a small top-notch.
Align the primary void/public opening to the verified access side in the program frame.
Strengthen the access-side terrace/threshold so the ground edge reads as a legible public seam rather than a sealed face.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent dominant mass in all four views, with a clear stepped/cantilevered section and a recognizable carved court/void at the top. It is not especially fragmented and the parcel containment appears respected. The main weakness is the access response: the thick blue frontage is acknowledged, but the ground-edge/public threshold is modest rather than strongly legible, so the void-publicness score stays middling. Programmatically it can plausibly support neighborhood living / mixed-use because the mass has a compact street-building character and a usable open figure, but the section is somewhat sculptural and the lower level does not yet read as fully active or inviting. Reference 1 and 2 support the idea of a compact commercial/courtyard mass with a meaningful public void; reference 4 is only loosely relevant as a grounded base strategy; reference 5 is counterfactual and suggests a transferable bridge/connect operation rather than a copied form.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More facade/restaurant-specific than the candidate; use for active-threshold logic, not stylistic copying.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Compact commercial massing with a carved/filtered ground condition and a clear sheltered public edge.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Image is atmospheric and material-heavy; treat only the courtyard/public-room relationship as transferable.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Courtyard-centered neighborhood scale with strong enclosure and lush public void as the primary spatial figure.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Predominantly interior/fit-out reference; limited massing transfer beyond threshold clarity.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Small commercial frontage with a simple, legible street response and calm envelope above.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Typology is much larger and more vertical; only the base/public-realm mediation is useful.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Grounded tower/stack strategy where the base mediates public realm and upper mass stays distinct.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Intentional counterfactual; useful to propose a connected/bridging operation, but not a direct precedent for this compact neighborhood brief.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Bridge-like spanning and elongated public circulation as a counterpoint to isolated object-massing.

warnings: Access-edge response is weaker than the rest of the massing language; the blue frontage is not yet converted into a strong public threshold.
The section is somewhat object-like and could read as a sculpted stack rather than a clearly inhabited neighborhood building.
Void is present but not fully public-facing in the way the brief asks.
